Prototype 1 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EEG (61%), with EOG (27%) and EMG (11%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows absence of θ (-4.1 dB, sensitivity=12.7) and suppressed α (-1.4 dB, sensitivity=8.2).
The θ activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with moderate eye movements (REM 0% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is conflicting with REM physiology: missing: EOG dominant, EMG atonic, θ elevated.
